Every entry below is the docstring of the installed package, printed at render time, so this
page is as current as the version the site was rendered against (shown on the
[Python page](index.qmd)).

```{python}
#| echo: false
import inspect, re
import convinterp

def docstring(obj):
    """Print a NumPy-style docstring as Markdown, with headings below the page's own."""
    lines = (inspect.getdoc(obj) or "").splitlines()       # the docstring, dedented, line by line
    out = []                                                # the Markdown lines
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        # a section heading is a title line underlined with dashes
        if i + 1 < len(lines) and re.fullmatch(r"-{3,}", lines[i + 1].strip()):
            title = line.strip()
            out.append(f"#### {title}")
            i += 2
            if title in ("Example", "Examples"):           # a doctest becomes a code block
                code = []
                while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip():
                    code.append(lines[i])
                    i += 1
                out += ["```python", *code, "```"]
            else:                                           # "name : type" items with indented descriptions
                while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip():
                    item = lines[i]
                    if " : " in item:
                        name, kind = item.split(" : ", 1)
                        head = f"- `{name.strip()}` ({kind.strip()}):"
                    else:
                        head = f"- `{item.strip()}`:"
                    i += 1
                    desc = []
                    while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("    "):
                        desc.append(lines[i].strip())
                        i += 1
                    out.append(head + " " + " ".join(desc))
            continue
        out.append(line)
        i += 1
    print("\n".join(out))
```
